paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Recall@50 and NDCG@50 performance metrics over an increasing search depth. The x-axis is linear, ranging from 1 to 5, with tick labels spaced at intervals of one, and the y-axis is logarithmic, ranging from 0.10 to 0.35, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. The line labeled “Recall@ours” (dark orange circles) begins at a value of approximately 0.60 at x=1 and decreases to approximately 0.35 at x=5. The line labeled “Recall@50 (ours)” (green dotted line) starts at around 0.60 at x=1 and decreases to approximately 0.25 at x=5. The line labeled “NDCG@ours” (blue solid line) begins at around 0.50 at x=1 and decreases to approximately 0.20 at x=5.  The line labeled “NDCG@ReFICR” (blue dashed line) starts at around 0.45 at x=1 and decreases to approximately 0.15 at x=5.
